market_outlook.short_term: Oil above $100 remains the dominant cross-asset driver, pressuring bonds and creating volatility. Tech rally stalling as oil snaps losing run. Dow's third straight losing week signals broad risk-off. US-China positive tone provides partial offset. Expect choppy, range-bound equities with energy outperforming. AI rotation from hardware to software continues.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle intact but with growing liability concerns (Burry $3T warning). Diesel shortage into 2027 sustains energy premium. APAC M&A boom to 2027 per Goldman. US-China stabilization supports global risk appetite. GLP-1 competition reshapes pharma. Canada-Asia trade pivot diversifies supply chains. Structural shift toward AI-powered infrastructure (nuclear data centers, AI air traffic) defines next decade.
